normal_logging_contract: GSP uses LibOS logging rather than the ordinary host NvLog path.
Logging metadata, format text and filenames are emitted separately and removed from the final GPU-loaded image.
The public decoder consumes a supplied ELF and looks for.logging_metadata first, then.logging; format/name resolution uses that ELF mapping.
The inspected original logger packs the metadata argument as a relative address token with count/task fields; it does not treat that token as directly available format text in the loaded image.
correction: Earlier empty slices for these references were out of range, not evidence of empty stored strings. No function/type name is inferred from those slices.
limits: This explains a diagnostic-resolution boundary, not a hidden-memory mechanism.
Availability and exact identity of a matching vendor logging ELF remain open; absence from the inspected loaded image is not a claim that no companion exists.

normal_optional_contract: The normal GA100/TU11X/TU10X family branch selects the gsp_log_tu10x basename for GSP_LOG.
The platform macro prefixes the driver version and adds.bin.
Normal module firmware declarations omit optional gsp_log files.
The log-decoder setup returns normally when no logging ELF is supplied. With one supplied it uses the normal matching-container checks and selected logging section; no checks were altered.
normal_companion_followup.query_scope: Normal installed NVIDIA615.71.09 firmware directories and selected local CMP artifact inventories.
normal_companion_followup.limits: Scoped absence only; no global vendor-availability claim, specific diagnostic-name resolution or memory/clock/process-state refresh.
